args.name: ONE LAST TRY — Gaming Challenge Thumbnail

style.prompt: Create a bright, punchy, professional 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for a gaming challenge. Clear two-part composition, instantly readable on a small phone screen. RIGHT HALF: huge close-up face of an entirely invented adult gamer, expressive wide eyes, raised eyebrows, mouth open in exaggerated shock, wearing gaming headphones, photorealistic with dramatic lighting and a bold yellow rim light, face fills the right side. LEFT HALF: the exact three words "ONE LAST TRY" in enormous uppercase heavy condensed block lettering, arranged as ONE / LAST / TRY, white and vivid yellow with thick dark outlines and a strong drop shadow, perfectly legible and contained within generous safe margins. No other text or lettering. Background: stylized abstract video game obstacle challenge, electric blue and purple gradients, hot orange accents, glowing game-like platforms and explosive graphic energy streaks, slightly blurred for separation. Strong high contrast, saturated colors, clean visual hierarchy, polished cutout face, dynamic but uncluttered. Text must not overlap or obscure the face. No logos, no watermarks.
